name: GlzMorphCard
semanticRole: Represent content that can spatially transform into its detail view while preserving shared identity, selection state, and recoverable navigation.

material.rule: Readable content stays on Surface or Raised material; Regular Glaze may be used only for a genuinely spatial floating transition context, not as the default card body.

input.keyboard: Keyboard operation follows the component's semantic role; no required action depends on pointer-only interaction.
input.focus: Focus is visible, deterministic, and restored or moved according to the component's spatial transformation.
input.hover: Hover may enrich presentation but never exposes the only path to essential information or actions.
input.press: Press feedback is immediate and does not wait for decorative animation before semantic state changes.

accessibility.role: Use link, button, article, or group semantics according to whether the card navigates, invokes, or contains controls; never create nested conflicting activation.
accessibility.name: The primary interactive card action has a clear accessible name based on its content title and destination/action.
accessibility.state: Expose selected, expanded, busy, disabled, and error state without relying on animated geometry.
accessibility.value: The card itself has no synthetic value; nested progress, selection, or media controls expose their own values.
accessibility.keyboard: Enter activates the primary navigation/action when the card itself is interactive; Tab reaches nested controls without double activation.
accessibility.focus: Focus remains associated with the transformed object or moves to the detail heading; closing restores a meaningful origin focus.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Errors remain associated with the affected control or content and are announced without color-only meaning.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Replace the 320–440ms shared-element spatial expansion with a short crossfade or direct navigation.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Replace translucent material with an opaque surface while preserving hierarchy and boundaries.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen focus, boundaries, selected state, and text contrast without changing semantics.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system colors, visible focus, and remove decorative gradients, blur, and shadows.
accessibility.largeText: Reflow at 200% text without clipping essential labels, actions, sources, or state.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Replace the 320–440ms shared-element spatial expansion with a short crossfade or direct navigation.
fallbacks.reducedTransparency: Replace translucent material with an opaque surface while preserving hierarchy and boundaries.
fallbacks.highContrast: Strengthen focus, boundaries, selected state, and text contrast without changing semantics.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors, visible focus, and remove decorative gradients, blur, and shadows.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur, ambient gradients, decorative shadows, and nonessential morphing before changing semantic structure, target geometry, focus, or readable contrast.

content.overflow: Content clamps in compact cards but the destination detail view exposes the full title and content; actions never overlap clamped text.
content.localization: Titles and metadata tolerate 30–50% expansion; geometry grows or wraps before truncating primary identity.
content.rtl: Shared-element geometry follows logical layout and does not assume left-to-right origin or action placement.

criteria: Primary image/icon, title, accent identity, and selection state preserve continuity into detail.
The card reads as content first, not as decorative glass.
Reduced Motion removes spatial travel without changing destination or focus semantics.
